page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr9i.24xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The processing power is delivered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a base frequency of 3.4 GHz.

This instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external block storage volumes. Additionally, the instance features a baseline network bandwidth of 48 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There are no integrated graphics processing units on this instance.

The high memory-to-vCPU ratio makes this instance class suitable for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention. However, the lack of local storage and GPU acceleration represents a tradeoff, requiring external storage configuration and making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or deep learning workloads. Recommended workloads include large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning applications, and memory-heavy data processing pipelines.
